name: 1949: 10-8-7-6-5, Fastest-lap bonus, best three Round scores
source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1949_Grand_Prix_motorcycle_racing_season#Scoring_system (points to the top five finishers: 10-8-7-6-5, plus one point for the finisher with the fastest lap; in the 350cc and 500cc championships only the best three results counted). Cross-checked by the final 500cc table: every Rider's counted points reproduce from the Results. To be re-checked by hand against motogp.com before this rule is published.
notes: 500cc only. The Fastest-lap bonus goes to a finisher whatever their position: Graham pushed his bike over the line in 10th at the Isle of Man TT and kept the point.
